NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 30, 10:35 PM ET

The Bengals are the top-projected defense on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 7.5 DraftKings points for $3,800, against Tennessee. Jaguars (7.3, $3,700) and Rams (7.3, $3,500) are next.

The Broncos return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.65 projected points per $1,000 at $2,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 30, 10:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 8

Bengals, CIN vs TEN ($3,800)

Bengals carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.5 DraftKings points at $3,800. That is 0.2 points clear of Jaguars. The salary works out to 1.97 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 7 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Bengals averaged 7.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.7, and it holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 12.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Broncos, DEN vs KC ($2,300)

Broncos projects for 6.1 DraftKings points at $2,300, which works out to 2.65 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Broncos averaged 6.2 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 17.0, and it holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Denver is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Kansas City, with an implied team total of 19.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
